description: Frame blending (Layer > Frame Blending): set layers to Off, Frame Mix or Pixel Motion (the layer's Frame Blending switch), and turn the composition's Enable Frame Blending switch on or off, without which layer frame blending is not previewed

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

compSwitch.description: The composition's Enable Frame Blending switch

layers.description: Layers based on motion footage or compositions. Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

mode.description: For the layers: off, frame_mix or pixel_motion

name: set_frame_blending
title: Set Frame Blending
